command: for d in /sys/class/power_supply/*/; do for f in "$d"*; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; v=$(timeout 2 head -c 160 "$f" 2>&1 | tr "\n" " ") || v="<error>"; echo "$f=$v"; done; done

ls /sys/class/wakeup 2>&1 | head -5; echo "count=$(ls /sys/class/wakeup 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"; for f in name active_count total_time_ms; do echo "wakeup0/$f=$(cat /sys/class/wakeup/wakeup0/$f 2>&1)"; done
